text:
Anya: Quick async inventory for the quarter — short answers please: what shipped, what slipped, owners, and 1 next step each. I’ll kick off with infra-facing stuff from product side.

Mike: Payments V2 — shipped last week (owner: Mike). Verified by analytics, no regressions. Next: publish migration notes to /docs and ping integrators. :tada:

Leila: Runtime v3 (dedicated/private toggle) — slipped. Root cause: driver compatibility bug with the 5300-series GPU image. Owner: Leila + SUHAS for infra patch. ETA: PR Tuesday. Next step: schedule a short canary once patch lands. @Suhas

Suhas: Confirmed — storage/driver patch in progress. Blocker was kernel mismatch with our custom kernel. Working on backport now. ETA EOD Mon for patch, Tue for canary image build. Will post CI link in this thread.

Mike: Autoscale policy updates for Dedicated — partially shipped (policy config + API), but metrics routing slipped (depend on eng-infra). Owner: Mike. Next: @Suhas can you expose the new route for prometheus?

Suhas: Yep. I’ll open the infra-change PR today and link prometheus job. ETA for complete routing: Wed.

Leila: Feature gating for rollout — we need Product signoff on percentage targets. @Anya can you confirm thresholds?

Anya: Proposed thresholds: 5% canary, 25% ramp after 24h stability, 100% by 72h if no regressions. If a metric regresses >3% we roll back. Sounds OK?

Product-Ops: Looks fine from compliance POV. Add extra logging for latency p95 during ramp.

DevBot: deploy-bot: payments-v2 deployed to prod at 2024-09-14T18:12:03Z — success.

Leila: OK — runtime v3 next step: Leila to create the canary checklist + CRs, Suhas to supply patched image, Product (Anya) to confirm thresholds. I’ll send checklist by EOD.

Mike: Code review pings: 3 open PRs blocking autoscale metrics — @Leila can you take a look at #3421? small change, 2 tests.

Leila: I’ll triage #3421 after I finish the canary checklist. If it’s small I can do today.

Anya: For visibility, summary for leadership: Payments V2 shipped; Runtime v3 slipped (driver fix underway); Dedicated autoscale partially shipped, metrics routing delayed. Owners and ETAs inline. I’ll update the milestone board after we confirm the canary image.

Suhas: Linking driver patch PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/driver-patch/123 (will update status).

Mike: Thanks all. If anyone needs to swap owners to unblock, DM me. Short async check done. :white_check_mark:
